dialogue.speaker: Dedue
dialogue.text: This season's fish are best kept simple. Grill them cleanly, or steam them with herbs.

dialogue.speaker: Ashe
dialogue.text: You know so much about this, Dedue. I thought I was decent in a kitchen, but now I feel like a beginner.

bridge_actions.text: Dedue lifts a small herb bundle.
Ashe crouches beside the basket without crowding him.
